LANGUAGES

57 languages for voice dictation

Speech Recognition Cloud dictates in 57 languages on the Free, Personal, and Professional plans — including 34 European languages. Every language is included at no extra cost. Select one in settings, or leave it on Auto-Detect and the application identifies what you are speaking.

How language support works

Included on every paid plan

All 57 languages are included on Personal ($99/year) and Professional ($159/year). No language packs, no add-ons, no per-language pricing.

Auto-Detect for multilingual work

Leave the setting on Auto-Detect and the application identifies the language you are speaking. Select a single language explicitly for the best accuracy.

No voice training in any language

There are no voice profiles to build and no calibration step, in any supported language. Install and start dictating.

Works in any Windows application

Dictate at the cursor in Word, Outlook, Teams, Chrome, and web forms — in any of the supported languages.

Automatic punctuation

Punctuation and capitalisation are applied automatically across supported languages, not just English.

Medical plan is English only

Medical vocabularies are built for English clinical terminology. Clinicians dictating in another language should use the Professional plan.

Test your language free

20 minutes per month. No credit card. Install in 2 minutes.

Language questions

How many languages does Speech Recognition Cloud support?

Speech Recognition Cloud supports 57 languages on the Free, Personal, and Professional plans. The full list is published on this page. The Medical plan is English only, because the specialised medical vocabularies are built for English clinical terminology.

Do I need a different plan or licence for another language?

No. All 57 languages are included on the Free, Personal, and Professional plans at no extra cost. You select your language in the application settings, or leave it on Auto-Detect.

Can I dictate in more than one language?

Yes. Leave the language setting on Auto-Detect and the application will identify the language you are speaking. If you work in a single language, selecting it explicitly gives the best accuracy.

Is the interface translated into these languages?

No. The application interface is in English. The language setting controls the language you dictate in, not the language of the menus and settings.

Does the Medical plan support other languages?

No. The Medical plan is English only. Medical vocabularies covering drug names, anatomical terminology, eponyms, and procedural language are built for English clinical documentation. Clinicians who need to dictate in another language should use the Professional plan.

Does automatic punctuation work in every language?

Automatic punctuation and capitalisation are applied across the supported languages. Accuracy is strongest in the widely spoken European and Asian languages, which have the largest training data. Every plan includes a free tier, so you can test your own language before you buy.
